basic_details.job_title: KTDFC Company Secretary Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Kerala Transport Development Finance Corporation Limited (KTDFC), a Non Banking Financial Company fully owned by the Government of Kerala, has one contract vacancy for Company Secretary at Consolidated Pay 65,000. The post needs membership of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India and three years' experience. Applications are accepted only online through the Kerala Public Enterprises (Selection & Recruitment) Board from 20-11-2026 to 19-12-2026.

how_to_apply: Apply only through online mode between 20-11-2026 and 19-12-2026. Applications submitted through any other medium are summarily rejected.
Upload the essential qualification and essential experience certificates while applying. Applications of those who fail to upload them are summarily rejected.
Give a valid email ID and mobile number. All correspondence about the recruitment goes to the registered email ID and mobile number given in the online application.
SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates claiming reservation upload the relevant valid and updated certificate.
Pay the application fee: Rs.1000/-, or Rs.250/ for SC/ST candidates. The notice does not mention the payment mode.
Caste / Community / Non-Creamy Layer / EWS certificate, for reservation benefits
important_instructions: Applicants must read the notification and satisfy themselves about their eligibility before applying. Admittance to the written examination/skill test/interview is only provisional. The Board has the right not to evaluate a candidate's performance if a material discrepancy is found in the applications or credentials at any stage. The candidature of such applicants is rejected. Any form of canvassing or attempt to influence the selection process results in disqualification. The Board reserves the right to modify, postpone or cancel the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason. Candidates are advised to keep a print out of the completed online application form for future reference. Board contact given in the notice: [email protected], Tel 0471-2995042.

content_sections.heading: About KTDFC
content_sections.text: Kerala Transport Development Finance Corporation Limited is a Non Banking Financial Company fully owned by the Government of Kerala. It holds a valid certificate of Registration issued by the Reserve Bank of India under section 45 IA of the RBI Act 1934. The recruitment is conducted by the Kerala Public Enterprises (Selection & Recruitment) Board, Vellayambalam, VikasBhavan P.O, Thiruvananthapuram.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Qualification: Member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India. AICWAI shall be a preferable additional qualification. Experience: Three years' experience in a reputed organization after acquiring the qualification. Desirable: Experience in NBFC is desirable. Age: Maximum age of 35 years as on the date of Notification. Relaxation in the upper age limit is applicable to eligible candidates as per rules. SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates are eligible for reservation benefits as per rules, provided they upload valid and updated relevant certificates (Caste Certificate / Community Certificate / Non-Creamy Layer Certificate / EWS Certificate). Without valid certificates, no reservation benefits are granted.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post is a contract post with Consolidated Pay of 65,000. The contract appointment is initially for one year, which is extendable subject to the sole discretion of KTDFC.

content_sections.heading: KTDFC Company Secretary Job Description
content_sections.text: Convening and providing administration for Annual General Meetings (AGMs), for example preparing agendas, minutes, conveying decisions and handling meeting correspondences. Providing legal, financial and/or strategic advices. Ensuring compliance to all statutory and regulatory requirements and implementation of Board decisions. Maintenance of secretarial records, statutory books and registers. Any other responsibilities allocated, including internal audit and legal matters.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KTDFC Company Secretary

All correspondence about the recruitment goes to the registered email ID and mobile number given in the online application. SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates claiming reservation upload the relevant valid and updated certificate. Pay the application fee: Rs.1000/-, or Rs.250/ for SC/ST candidates. The notice does not mention the payment mode. faq.question: Q1. How many Company Secretary vacancies are there in KTDFC?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the contract post of Company Secretary at Kerala Transport Development Finance Corporation Limited, under Category No. 020/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the KTDFC Company Secretary post?
faq.answer: The closing date is 19-12-2026. Applications opened on 20-11-2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the KTDFC Company Secretary post?
faq.answer: The candidate must be a Member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India. AICWAI is a preferable additional qualification, and three years' experience in a reputed organization after acquiring the qualification is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the KTDFC Company Secretary post?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years as on the date of Notification. Relaxation in the upper age limit applies to eligible candidates as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for the KTDFC Company Secretary post?
faq.answer: The Consolidated Pay is 65,000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the KTDFC Company Secretary post?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.1000/-. For SC/ST candidates it is Rs.250/.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the KTDFC Company Secretary post?
faq.answer: Apply only online. Upload the essential qualification and experience certificates, and give a valid email ID and mobile number. Applications by any other medium are summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q8. Is the KTDFC Company Secretary post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a contract post. The contract is initially for one year and is extendable at the sole discretion of KTDFC.

faq.question: Q9. Is NBFC experience required for the KTDFC Company Secretary post?
faq.answer: No, it is desirable, not essential. The required experience is three years in a reputed organization after acquiring the qualification.

faq.question: Q10. Do SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates get reservation benefits?
faq.answer: Yes, as per rules, provided they upload valid and updated relevant certificates. Without valid certificates, no reservation benefits are granted.
